name: Production
description: Business domain covering the products Adventure Works Cycles sells or uses to manufacture what it sells: the product catalog and its classification, bills of materials, manufacturing work orders, inventory, prices and costs, and product documentation.

name: Product
description: An item sold by Adventure Works, or used in the manufacture of items it sells. A product belongs to a subcategory and a product model and has a unit of measure.

name: Product Category
description: The high-level classification of products, such as bikes, components, clothing and accessories.

name: Product Subcategory
description: A finer classification of products within a product category.

name: Product Model
description: A product model classification: the design that one or more products are built to, with its catalog description and manufacturing instructions.

name: Product Description
description: The descriptive text of a product model, available in several languages (cultures).

name: Bill of Materials
description: The items required to make bicycles and bicycle subassemblies, identifying the hierarchical relationship between a parent product and its components.

name: Work Order
description: A manufacturing order to make a quantity of a product, including the order's detailed routing through the manufacturing locations and any quantity scrapped.

name: Scrap Reason
description: A reason a manufactured item was scrapped, a manufacturing failure reason.

name: Inventory Location
description: A place where product inventory is held or manufacturing takes place.

name: Product Inventory
description: The quantity of a product held at a given inventory location.

name: Inventory Transaction
description: A record of each purchase order, sales order or work order transaction affecting a product, held for the current year and, as an archive, for previous years.

name: Product Cost History
description: The changes in the standard cost of a product over time.

name: Product List Price History
description: The changes in the list price of a product over time.

name: Product Review
description: A review of a product written by a customer who has purchased it.

name: Product Photo
description: An image of a product, and the link between products and their photos.

name: Product Document
description: A product maintenance document, and the link between products and the documents that relate to them.

name: Assembly Illustration
description: A bicycle assembly diagram, and the link between product models and their illustrations.

name: Unit of Measure
description: A unit in which quantities of products and components are measured.
